general.fontSizeDescription: Adjust the font size for UI and terminal.
general.keyboardShortcutsDescription: View and customize all keyboard shortcuts.

appearance.customCSSDescription: Override CSS variables to customize colors and styles.

terminal.themeDescription: Select terminal color themes for each mode.

editor.presetDescription: Choose which editor to open when clicking the EDITOR button in the header.
editor.urlDescription: Enter the web URL of your Code Server instance.
editor.urlHelp: Install and run code-server to use VS Code in the browser. The ?folder= parameter is automatically appended to the URL.
editor.customTemplateDescription: Enter a URL template that will be opened with the current folder.
editor.customHelp: Use <folder></folder> for the absolute path, or <folderEncoded></folderEncoded> for the URL-encoded path.
editor.localIdeHint: Opens the selected IDE locally. The IDE must be installed on the machine running the browser / desktop app.
editor.offHint: The editor button will be hidden from the header.
editor.errorHttpRequired: URL must start with http:// or https://

auth.changePasswordDescription: New passwords are hashed with SHA-512 before saving.

notification.enableDescription: Show system notifications when Codex tasks complete.
notification.permissionDenied: Browser notification permission denied. Please allow in browser settings.
notification.notSupported: Web Push is not supported in this browser.
notification.soundEnableDescription: Play a sound when a task-complete notification arrives. Background system notifications are silent when this is off.
notification.toastSectionDescription: Shows only while the window is in the foreground. System notifications handle the background.
notification.toastEnableDescription: A transient toast appears in addition to the sidebar count.
notification.toastDurationDescription: How long the toast stays before auto-dismiss.
notification.toastPositionDesktopDescription: Where toasts appear on wider screens.
notification.toastPositionMobileDescription: Where toasts appear on narrow screens.

agent.enableMenuDescription: Show the agent menu in the sidebar. This feature is currently in beta.

system.networkAccessDescription: Control which networks can reach codexwinmux. Takes effect after server restart.
system.networkAccessLocked: Controlled by the HOST environment variable.
system.restartRequired: Requires a server restart to take effect.

localhost.label: Localhost only
localhost.description: Only this machine. Most secure; port is closed to other devices.

tailscale.label: Localhost + Tailscale
tailscale.description: This machine and Tailscale peers. LAN and the public internet are blocked.

all.label: All interfaces
all.description: Allow connections from any reachable network, including LAN and the public internet.

system.showResourcesDescription: Display CPU, memory, and tmux session usage in the header.
system.attachedImagesDescription: Images attached to the input bar are stored under ~/.codexwinmux/uploads/. Files older than 24 hours are removed automatically on server start.
system.tmuxResetDescription: Terminates all tmux sessions and {action}. Use when settings changes need to be applied.
system.tmuxResetConfirm: All running terminal processes will be terminated. Continue?

tailscale.notInstalledDescription: Install Tailscale to securely access from outside your network.
tailscale.installGuide: For detailed installation instructions, visit <link>Tailscale official website</link>.
tailscale.nonDefaultPortTitle: Server is currently running on port {port}
tailscale.nonDefaultPortDescription: The default port ({defaultPort}) was in use, so a different port was automatically assigned. The auto-assigned port may change after {restartAction}, so it is recommended to set the local port to {defaultPort} instead of {currentPort} in Tailscale Serve settings.
tailscale.commentOrTerminate: # or terminate the process occupying port {port} and restart

quickPrompts.title: Quick Prompts
quickPrompts.description: Manage prompt buttons displayed above the input field.
quickPrompts.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Please review the current changes.
quickPrompts.resetDescription: All custom prompts will be deleted and built-in prompts will be enabled.
quickPrompts.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this prompt?

sidebarItems.title: Sidebar Items
sidebarItems.description: Manage shortcut items displayed at the bottom of the sidebar.
sidebarItems.resetDescription: All custom items will be deleted and built-in items will be enabled.
sidebarItems.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this item?

codex.modelDescription: Optional model passed as --model. Leave blank to use the Codex CLI default.
codex.sandboxDescription: Controls the --sandbox mode for new and resumed Codex sessions.
codex.approvalPolicyDescription: Controls when Codex asks before running commands.
codex.webSearchDescription: Adds --search so Codex can use live web search.
codex.showTerminalDescription: Display the terminal area alongside Codex. When off, new Codex tabs open with the terminal collapsed.
